# Third-party components

Third-party source components, when present, keep their original licenses and notices in this directory.

## Cascadia Code

`src/App/Assets/Fonts/CascadiaCode.ttf` is Cascadia Code, distributed under the
SIL Open Font License 1.1. See `cascadia-code/OFL.txt`. The font comes from the
[Google Fonts distribution](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/cascadiacode)
of [Microsoft Cascadia Code](https://github.com/microsoft/cascadia-code) and keeps
code blocks monospaced on Android.
